Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint

Interface Tool

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractTool, BrushTool, EllipseTool, EraserTool, EyedropperTool, FillTool, FreeformTool, FreehandTool, LineTool, PencilTool, PolygonTool, RectangleTool, SelectLassoTool, SelectRectTool, ShapeTool, SprayTool, TextTool
public interface Tool
A Paint tool. The active tool receives the mouse gestures that PaintCanvas translates into document coordinates and reacts through the shared PaintContext (document, tool settings, selection and the canvas callbacks).

The gesture lifecycle is press(java.awt.geom.Point2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) -> zero or more drag(java.awt.geom.Point2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) -> release(java.awt.geom.Point2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext). Freehand tools paint straight into the active layer as they go; shape tools keep their geometry in fields and render it through preview(java.awt.Graphics2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) (an overlay the canvas paints on top of the composite) until release(java.awt.geom.Point2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) commits it to the layer. activated(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext)/deactivated(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) bracket a tool's time as the current tool.
